steps.name: Introductory call
steps.text: Tell us about your land and how you want to use it.

steps.name: Site visit
steps.text: We walk your plot and check access, levels and views.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: Pick a model and finishes; we fit it to your land.

steps.name: Manufacturing
steps.text: Your home is made in our factory while the site is prepared.

steps.name: Installation
steps.text: The finished parts are put together on your land.

steps.name: Move in
steps.text: We hand over the keys to a ready home.
